This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No. 10 of 2024 registered at Police Station Dhirpura, District Datia (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376 of IPC & Sections 3/4 of POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

Allegedly, the prosecutrix got missing on 17.01.2024 and recovered on 18.01.2024 and in her first statement recorded u/S.161 of Cr.P.C. on 18.01.2024, she has not mentioned the name of present applicant/accused, however, in her statement recorded u/S.164 of Cr.P.C. on 19.01.2024,

sentences.text:
she improvised her version and stated that on 17.01.2024 co- accused persons namely, Vikas,
Vikram Jatav and present applicant offered her go to with them and she consented as she already knew all of them.
Co-accused Vikram and present applicant left the prosecutrix and Vikas in village Uchad, in these circumstances, there is no ingredients of offence of kidnapping against the present applicant.
It is further argued that allegation of sexual assault is not on present applicant/accused.

Earlier an FIR bearing crime no. 521/2023 was registered against co-accused Vikas for abducting and committing rape on the same prosecutrix, however, F.R. has been lodged in this case and the prosecutrix did not corroborate the case of prosecution, hence, the entire prosecution story becomes doubtful in respect to present applicant/accused.
Further submission is that applicant is the permanent resident of District Datia (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
P er contra, learned counsel for the State vehemently opposed the bail application and prays for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Having taking into consideration the entirety of the facts and material available on record, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with two local solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
In case, if he/she is found involving in the offence of the same nature, this bail order shall stand cancelled automatically without further reference to the Bench.

5) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and 6 ) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
